applicability.do_not_transfer_when: the target supplies an independent derivative/frequency monotonicity, positive-distance smoothing estimate with controlled constants, profile theorem, or other trace mechanism
applicability.works_when: a producer controls a zero-order scale-critical norm or integrated derivative ledger while a consumer requires a uniform-time critical derivative endpoint

lesson: Matching scaling dimensions do not license a producer-to-consumer implication across a derivative/time-trace interface. Before invoking the consumer, identify and verify the missing frequency/history/trace mechanism explicitly.
routing_rule: Reject interpolation/bookkeeping-only attempts to generate the critical derivative endpoint; prioritize a new trace mechanism or rotate to an orthogonal route.
